recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中出現大量成群聚集的中大型母細胞（blasts），高核質比、細緻染色質、少量嗜鹼性細胞質，數量遠超過成熟白血球，搭配慢性骨髓性白血病病史即為急性轉化（blast crisis）。
features: Numerous medium to large blasts, many clumped in small aggregates
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm without obvious granules at this power
Occasional smudged/degenerated cells and a granular fragmented cell
Rare maturing neutrophil; red cells unremarkable at this magnification
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-intermediate power shows a marked increase in circulating blasts, many forming small aggregates. The blasts are medium to large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm; maturing granulocytes are sparse and scattered smudged cells are present. Lineage cannot be assigned morphologically at this magnification. In a patient with known CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, the findings are consistent with blast phase; flow cytometry is required to distinguish myeloid from lymphoid blast phase.

ddx.vs: De novo disease lacks a prior chronic phase, basophilia and marked splenomegaly, and is separated by history and BCR-ABL1 transcript/cytogenetic pattern rather than blast morphology.
Lymphoblasts have scantier cytoplasm and denser chromatin, but distinction from lymphoid blast phase of CML requires flow cytometry and BCR-ABL1 in neutrophils/FISH.
Chronic phase shows a left-shifted spectrum dominated by myelocytes and segmented neutrophils with basophilia and few blasts, not sheets of blasts.
